reviewer: ab_harness agent; not one of tested Codex subprocesses; unblinded
method: Manual reading of all 26 final responses and all tool-command traces against pre-frozen 4 criteria per skill. Scores 0/1/2; quoted evidence and context retained. No self-score or keyword rubric.
scope: Single fictional tabletop per skill, gpt-6-astra/high only. No production completion or cross-model quality claim.

B.interpretation: Fixture rubric points, not a real-world quality percentage.
